name: yayaw-table-connector-google-sheets
title: YaYaw Table Google Sheets Connector
description: Optional, framework-agnostic server module that pushes table rows into a Google Sheets tab (upsert or replace, keyed by a "Yayaw ID" column) with a service account signed through Web Crypto, and syncs both ways with the shared sync engine. The host stores the key and the sync state, authorizes the push and calls it from its server.
